title: Function tests: verify a result and prove the test notices an error
goal: Write explicit checks for a pure function and test their sensitivity on a separately preserved incorrect copy.
prerequisites: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
outcomes: Separate inputs, independent expected results and assertions from implementation.
Check ordinary input, zero, one hour and rejection of a negative duration.
Mutate the formula in a copy and observe a failed check without claiming course credit.
sections: A test asks a question with an observable answer

An “all good” message does not compare anything. ПроверитьРавно accepts the actual value, an independently calculated expectation and a case name. A mismatch raises an exception and prevents the success message. The case name identifies the broken agreement.

Calculate 600 for 30 minutes at 1200 per hour independently. Calling the same formula twice would allow the same error on both sides. Keep the business example separate from the implementation that must satisfy it.
A small table checks different rules

Three numeric cases cover an ordinary calculation, allowed zero and a full hour. They do not cover every input or rounding rule. A one-hour case alone cannot expose every unit or rounding error. Choose additional cases from the contract, such as one minute or a fractional rate.

For the negative input, the rejection flag begins false, becomes true only on an exception, and is asserted afterward. An exception anywhere in a large program is not equivalent to the intended rejection. This exercise deliberately isolates one invalid call; professional tests also identify the expected rejection reason.

Preserve the working source. In a separate copy change division by 60 to division by 30. The source can still compile, but the first result becomes 1200 instead of 600. The “полчаса” case must stop execution and the final success message must not appear.

Restore the original formula and rerun the entire set. If the incorrect copy passes, verify the module and database update, assertion execution and success-message placement. Do not change the expected 600 to 1200 merely to obtain green output.
State the scope of the evidence

This function neither reads database records nor depends on an open form or writes documents. Small isolated inputs can therefore test it. Rights, document persistence, UI and concurrent access require different scenarios in an appropriate environment.

Preserve the source, case table, successful result, incorrect copy and observed failure. A Nexus self-report stores the learner’s statement. Local execution alone is not server grading, proof of authorship or an official certificate.

lab.title: Function tests: verify a result and prove the test notices an error
lab.environment: Official locally installed training platform; a separate personal file infobase, no Studio required.
steps: Calculate the three numeric expectations before running and explain the fourth Boolean expectation.

Close only your Enterprise session. Open your training infobase in Designer and open its managed application module from the configuration root. Preserve the entire preceding text separately: this example includes its declarations and one startup handler.

Replace the text of this training module with the complete main example. The function is outside the procedure. Do not nest the complete example inside the previous handler or keep two handlers with the same name.
Save your source, complete the database update and start Enterprise mode. Read the message area and compare each actual output with your prediction.
Run the original set. Preserve a copy and change only the function’s divisor from 60 to 30. After the expected failure restore 60 and rerun everything.

evidence: Source version, predicted and actual outputs.

lab.negative: Do not catch the entire set and then display success. Do not fit expectations to an incorrect formula or claim server assessment.

mistakes: Two identical wrong calculations can compare equal.
Calculate the expectation independently of the tested implementation.
Compilation does not prove formula correctness.
Assert the value and test sensitivity on a deliberately incorrect copy.
A pure-function test does not verify permissions, persistence or authorship.
Record the evidence scope and test permissions, persistence and UI separately.
